read.thesis: Copper guidance raised to 1,900–2,000 kt on record Escondida throughput, but WA Nickel and Potash negative EBITDA and a US$2.3–2.4 bn working-capital build weigh on cash; BMA guided to lower half.

utilisation.quote: record concentrator throughput and improved recoveries driven by operational enhancements

triggers.label: Group copper guidance raised to 1,900–2,000 kt
triggers.quote: Copper production guidance for FY26 has increased to between 1,900 and 2,000 kt

triggers.label: Copper realised price US$5.28/lb, up 32%
triggers.quote: copper prices up 32% and iron ore prices 4% higher year on year

triggers.label: Working capital outflow US$2.3–2.4 bn
triggers.quote: Increase in working capital (lower operating cash flow)

triggers.label: Samarco phase 3 capacity to ~26 Mtpa
triggers.quote: Samarco will invest US$2.4 bn (100% basis) to lift production capacity to ~26 Mtpa

guidance.quote: Copper production guidance for FY26 has increased to between 1,900 and 2,000 kt
Production guidance for FY26 has been increased to between 1,200 and 1,275 kt
Copper production guidance for FY26 has been increased to between 140 and 150 kt
production now expected to be in the lower half of the range

The Group's net debt balance as at 31 December 2025 is expected to be between US$14 and US$15 bn.
